name: Brian Nathan

items.text: A Republican ad used a photo of Nathan at a May 3, 2025 May Day event in Ybor City to call him a socialist. Creative Loafing reports the event was a union-focused International Workers' Day protest. It included the Party for Socialism and Liberation, and the West Central Florida Labor Council helped organize it.
items.why: Speaking at a labor rally that other groups also organized is a campaign attack built on association, with no finding of wrongdoing and no clear bearing on any criterion.

for_review: The Tampa Bay Times article on the socialism mailers (Oct. 14, 2026) was paywalled when opened, so I only saw its search snippet. The snippet says Nathan called the allegations lies and denied any socialist or communist affiliation, and that the Florida Republican Senatorial Campaign Committee paid for the mailers. Neither point is in the voter text. The Florida's Voice piece is labeled opinion/analysis and is a conservative outlet. It adds a 2012 voter-registration form listing a minor party, which is not conduct that bears on any criterion. The owner-site search (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) returned nothing about Nathan. Nathan won re-election on Nov. 3, 2026, according to Creative Loafing's unofficial results, so the ballot context may need updating.
